query:
SELECT 
  id,
  title,
  address,
  district,
  sourceUrl,
  ownerPhone,
  ownerWhatsapp,
  ownerEmail,
  source,
  createdAt
FROM properties 
ORDER BY createdAt DESC 
LIMIT 20;
